        ### Question
        A 58-year-old woman presents to the physician for a routine gynecological visit. She denies any acute issues and remarks that she has not been sexually active for the past year. Which of the following approaches to cervical cancer screening is most appropriate for this patient?

opb. Colposcopy in 3 years
opc. Discontinue screening until the patient becomes sexually active
opd. Pap test and HPV test in 5 years
ope. Pap test only in 5 years
